value: Process id becomes part of the BaseShim device status pane generally, not just the ground loop's.

This one is NOT ready and is cast resting at THINKME rather than BUILDME. A shim's pid is only meaningful once devices are separate OS processes — which is exactly what Akien's ruling enables (the loop scans disk and posts to the bus, so the heartbeat no longer holds in-process references) but which is NOT yet built. Today every shim shares the pid of whatever process constructed it, so a pid field would report a true number that means nothing. Casting it at BUILDME would invite building a field that is honest-looking and empty.
ABSORBED 2026-08-11 — needs transferred to parent every-device-has-a-presence child (b); the stage they referenced (BUILDME) is not in this absorbed ticket's vocabulary

value.why: This ticket's recorded why — 'every device answers am I running, and as what, the same way' — IS that child. The parent generalizes it: the answer is three states (never-booted / running / offline-with-last-known), and the pid becomes a FIELD of the running state rather than a pane element of its own. Absorbed rather than worked in parallel, so one question does not get two builds. The blocker recorded here in HELD_AT_THINKME_ON_PURPOSE is unchanged and is now the parent's first open question: a pid is only meaningful once devices are separate OS processes, and no shim spawns one yet.
